title: Take a Walk
speaker: Antwan Cronje
summary: In part 2 of the series, Pastor Antwan shows us how the Holy Spirit helps us to grow and change to become more like Jesus.
quotes: Jesus didn't defeat death so that we can live a defeated life.
A Spirit-filled life is a Word-filled life.
Any Bible study that only focuses on knowledge and not application only serves to make you more religious.
